setup.text: A serious accident leaves (craftsperson), a craftsperson, with lasting impairment in one hand.

choices.label: Ask the Craftsperson About Their Goals
Respect Their Right to Refuse Help

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: They develop a slower technique that suits their priorities.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: They decide to pursue a different craft rather than reclaim their old role.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: A modified grip makes some familiar tasks possible.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: Several adaptations fail before a useful one is found.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: (craftsperson) speaks openly about what they miss.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: They prefer ordinary conversation to constant reassurance.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: (craftsperson) completes a task independently with satisfaction.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: They later request help on their own terms, without shame.
